tagline: Cinematic location vlogs: your own footage cut fast, big yellow keywords with handwritten connector words, a quiet pale-lemon serif subtitle, and paper-card examples that loop back to the first frame.
needs: you talking in a few places + lots of your own B-roll (a drone or overhead shot helps)
readiness_note: Best with 20-40 of your own B-roll clips per minute (places, details, hands, a drone or overhead shot); with fewer, it falls back to re-crops and paper cards.

captions: F-A hook: script connectors and yellow keyword blocks slide in over a moving location shot
Behind-the-head keyword and the cream serif subtitle on a talking piece
F-B paper card on cream with yellow ink arrows and a guide line
